subject.title: fix(heartbeat): remove static iteration cap in seekNextActivePhaseDueMs

question: Should OpenClaw land this bounded active-hours seek for already-accepted sub-minute/sub-second heartbeat intervals after resolving conflicts, or pause to change the interval support policy instead?
rationale: The code path fixes a real scheduler gap, but it changes upgrade-visible timing for existing accepted heartbeat intervals and the PR is currently dirty against main.

options.title: Resolve Conflicts And Land
options.body: Keep the PR's bounded seek shape, resolve current main conflicts, rerun exact-head checks, and accept the documented compatibility and availability risk.

options.title: Ask For More Timing Proof
options.body: Request one more production-path timing transcript for the smallest accepted interval before deciding whether the synchronous seek budget is acceptable.

options.title: Pause For Interval Policy
options.body: If maintainers do not want active-hours scheduling to support sub-minute heartbeat intervals, pause this PR and handle that as an explicit config policy decision.

recommendation.title: Resolve Conflicts And Land
recommendation.body: Keep the PR's bounded seek shape, resolve current main conflicts, rerun exact-head checks, and accept the documented compatibility and availability risk.
